st: Facebook becomes Meta, but will it manage to build the metaverse?

sec.t: ff.3.1 What are you really, Meta? (part 1)
sec.p: Facebook, WhatsApp, Instagram and "the whole gang" have been put under the mask of Meta.

sec.t: ff.3.2 What are you really, Meta? (part 2)
sec.p: In the chat below, Mark Zuckerberg talks about the process that led him to Meta and what he'll try to integrate.
Some argue that, despite Meta's visibility and reach, there are systems much closer to the metaverse than those offered by Mark's suite.

What Discord is: Discord was born as a calling server to guarantee clean conversations, without lag or robotic voices. Adopted first in the gaming world, today it has a range of uses, with servers devoted to finance, learning and cryptocurrencies.
As Mark said in the previous interview, getting to the metaverse takes a lot of new technologies, like brain-computer interfaces.

sec.t: ff.3.7 Tokens that cost as much as a Lamborghini
sec.p: NF… what? NFTs are digital units owned uniquely and validated with the blockchain. This newsletter is already too long for a detailed explanation. We'll come back to it.

rel: ff.15 A taste of the metaverse
